chk_inventory_reason.name: chk_inventory_reason
chk_inventory_reason.value: "inventory_movements"."movement_type" NOT IN ('WASTE_LOSS', 'COUNT_ADJUSTMENT') OR "inventory_movements"."notes" IS NOT NULL

chk_subscription_paid_plan.name: chk_subscription_paid_plan
chk_subscription_paid_plan.value:
"store_subscriptions"."plan_tier" = 'CASERO' OR "store_subscriptions"."status" <> 'ACTIVE'
        OR ("store_subscriptions"."billing_interval" IS NOT NULL AND "store_subscriptions"."current_period_end" IS NOT NULL)

chk_users_store_role.name: chk_users_store_role
chk_users_store_role.value:
("users"."role" IN ('STORE_OWNER', 'STORE_EMPLOYEE') AND "users"."store_id" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("users"."role" IN ('PLATFORM_ADMIN', 'CUSTOMER', 'PENDING_OWNER') AND "users"."store_id" IS NULL)

chk_sales_modality_payment.name: chk_sales_modality_payment
chk_sales_modality_payment.value:
("sales"."sale_modality" = 'CASH' AND "sales"."payment_method" <> 'CREDIT')
        OR ("sales"."sale_modality" <> 'CASH' AND "sales"."payment_method" = 'CREDIT' AND "sales"."customer_id" IS NOT NULL)

chk_charges_installments.name: chk_charges_installments
chk_charges_installments.value:
("credit_charges"."charge_modality" = 'INSTALLMENTS'
          AND "credit_charges"."installments_count" IS NOT NULL AND "credit_charges"."grace_days" IS NOT NULL AND "credit_charges"."capitalized_amount" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("credit_charges"."charge_modality" = 'SINGLE_PAYMENT'
          AND "credit_charges"."installments_count" IS NULL AND "credit_charges"."grace_days" IS NULL AND "credit_charges"."capitalized_amount" IS NULL)

chk_allocations_target.name: chk_allocations_target
chk_allocations_target.value: ("payment_allocations"."credit_charge_id" IS NOT NULL)::INT + ("payment_allocations"."credit_installment_id" IS NOT NULL)::INT = 1

chk_notifications_digest.name: chk_notifications_digest
chk_notifications_digest.value: ("notification_logs"."notification_type" = 'CHARGE_DIGEST') = ("notification_logs"."digest_date" IS NOT NULL AND "notification_logs"."customer_id" IS NOT NULL)
